Function Documentation

HxResult HxStorageBeginWrite ( int  index  ) 

Put the storage in writable mode.

This function puts the storage specified with the index in writable mode. Any application has to call this function prior to writing on the mounted storage. Otherwise the attempt to write would usually fail because the system usually put the media in read-only mode to protect it from the filesystem corruption by accidental eject.

Parameters:
index IN: Index for the storage
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxStorageEndWrite ( int  index  ) 

Remove the storage from writable mode.

This function informs the system that the storage can go back into read-only mode. The application who has finished write operations should immediately call this function. If multiple applications have called HxStorageBeginWrite, the storage is not going back to read-only mode until the last application calls HxStorageEndWrite.

Parameters:
index IN: Index for the storage
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

Format the storage.

This function create a new file system on the storage.

Parameters:
index IN: Index for the storage
name IN: Name for the storage
type IN: Format type for the storage
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful, or HX_RESOURCES_LOCKED if the storage is locked.

HxResult HxStorageMountVolume ( int  index  ) 

Mount the storage.

This function mounts the storage specified with the index that has not been auto-mounted (e.g. the storage unmounted by HXStorageUnmount).

Parameters:
index IN: Index for the storage
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxStorageUnmountVolume ( int  index  ) 

Unmount the storage.

This function unmounts the auto-mounted storage specified with the index in order to do some operations on the storage that cannot be done while it is mounted (e.g. formatting)

Parameters:
index IN: Index for the storage
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
